player_prompt.intro:
Ad kem-ixelḍ {N} imḍanen usligin s wakka.
Di krayat tikkelt, sekci [accept] akken ad d-tafem imḍan *agdidan*, neɣ [continue] akken ad t-sḥebsi-t  d-tafem win n d-awtani.
Ma yella ur d-tafem, ad kem-xedmeḍ ad d-tafem imḍan aneggaru.
Ternuḍ (tazmert = 1) **kan** ma d imḍan i d-ternuḍ d win meqqren akk.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Taɣawsa ilaq ad tili d [accept] neɣ [continue].
